name: Ca chach kho
summary: Loach braised in a clay pot, sold as cá chạch kho niêu and as cá chạch kho Nghĩa Hưng. It belongs to the coastal districts of Hải Hậu, Nghĩa Hưng, and Giao Thủy.
origin: Nghĩa Hưng on the OCOP line. The coastal list also names Hải Hậu and Giao Thủy. Both stay.
where: Nghĩa Hưng, and the coastal districts of Hải Hậu and Giao Thủy.
seoTitle: Ca chach kho — a Nghia Hung name
seoDescription: Loach braised in a clay pot, a product of Nghĩa Hưng and the Nam Định coast.
